text:
Maria C: Quick sync — postmortem action list from last night's redis flapping. I pulled together a short plan for alert tuning + ownership so we stop paging for noisy keys.
Lee W: thanks. can we keep this lightweight? last time the rule changes created huge gaps.
Maria C: absolutely. goal is incremental: lower noise first, then dedupe. propose three tasks: 1) threshold retune, 2) dedupe window, 3) add suppression for known maintenance windows.
Amar S: I can own the dedupe window. estimate 2 days to test in staging and 1 day rollout.
Maria C: awesome — Amar, please add the proposed suppression rule you'll use and where it'll live (grafana/ops-radar).
Amar S: plan: implement dedupe as an aggregator in the alert pipeline w/ 5m soft-window + 30m suppression for identical signature. test query:
```
alert: redis_high_cmd_latency
expr: avg_over_time(redis_cmd_latency_seconds[1m]) > 0.25
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: paged
annotations:
  signature: '{{ $labels.instance }}:{{ $labels.command }}'
```
Maria C: perfect. Lee, can you take thresholds? start by moving 95th -> 99th percentile for the heavy background keys.
Lee W: yea. I'll run a 30-day trend and propose new cutoffs by EOD tomorrow. will include expected reduction %.
Ops Radar: (automated) Incident#4532 closed by maria.c — creating follow-up task 'redis-alert-retune'
Maria C: For suppression scheduling, we should not suppress during deploys where we need visibility. Amar — include a whitelist for deploy tags.
Amar S: will do. also going to add a label for "expected-flap" to avoid dedupe removing new root-cause alerts.
Lee W: timeline check — Amar 3 days to staged rollout, Lee 2 days for thresholds analysis, Maria to coordinate canary and approval. target: 2024-11-08 for canary start.
Maria C: owners & deadlines condensed:
- Amar S: dedupe & suppression implementation — due 2024-11-05
- Lee W: threshold analysis & PR with suggested values — due 2024-11-04
- Maria C: canary plan, rollback playbook, monitor dashboard updates — due 2024-11-07
Amar S: noted. I'll post PR link and test logs in this thread when ready.
Lee W: I'll attach the percentiles and expected token count impact. trying to keep cost/negligible perf tradeoffs.
Maria C: one more ask — set up a recurring 2-week sweep for noisy alerts. small owners group to sign off. volunteers?
Lee W: I'll take the first two sweeps.
Amar S: happy to join.
Ops Radar: (automated) Task created: redis-alert-retune assigned to [Amar S, Lee W, Maria C] due 2024-11-07
oncall-bot: Reminder — pls add short runbook lines to the alert definition: how to triage, how to silence, runbook link.
Maria C: good call. I added a short blurb to the draft rules and will update runbook. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-high-latency
Lee W: quick question — do we want a global dedupe in the router or per-service? per-service avoids cross-noise but duplicates work.
Amar S: prefer per-service for now. global later if we see cross-service storms.
Maria C: agreed. final: can everyone reply 'ack' when you've added your items to the project board?
Lee W: ack
Amar S: ack
Maria C: thanks — I'll follow up with canary schedule and brief the oncall before rollout. :thumbsup:
